mapper.select:
select pfc.five_classification_id, pfc.five_classification_number, pfc.CREATION_DATE, pfc.status, (select v.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v v where v.code = 'ASSESS_RESULT' AND v.code_value = pfc.status)status_n, (select count(*) from plm_five_classify_con pfcc where pfcc.five_classification_id = pfc.five_classification_id) all_number, ( case when (select count(*) from plm_five_classify_con pfcc where pfcc.five_classification_id = pfc.five_classification_id AND pfcc.change_iq = 'NORMAL' AND pfcc.approval_node = 'END_NODE') > 0 then (select count(*) from plm_five_classify_con pfcc where pfcc.final_classification_result = 'LOSS' AND pfcc.five_classification_id = pfc.five_classification_id AND pfcc.change_iq = 'NORMAL' AND pfcc.approval_node = 'END_NODE') else ( select count(*) from plm_five_classify_con pfcc where pfcc.final_classification_result = 'LOSS' AND pfcc.five_classification_id = pfc.five_classification_id AND pfcc.change_iq = 'NORMAL' AND pfcc.approval_node = 'FIRST_NODE' ) end ) AS loss_number,
( case when (select count(*) from plm_five_classify_con pfcc where pfcc.five_classification_id = pfc.five_classification_id AND pfcc.change_iq = 'NORMAL' AND pfcc.approval_node = 'END_NODE') > 0 then (select count(*) from plm_five_classify_con pfcc where pfcc.final_classification_result = 'SUSPICIOUS' AND pfcc.five_classification_id = pfc.five_classification_id AND pfcc.change_iq = 'NORMAL' AND pfcc.approval_node = 'END_NODE') else ( select count(*) from plm_five_classify_con pfcc where pfcc.final_classification_result = 'SUSPICIOUS' AND pfcc.five_classification_id = pfc.five_classification_id AND pfcc.change_iq = 'NORMAL' AND pfcc.approval_node = 'FIRST_NODE' ) end ) AS suspicious_number,
( case when (select count(*) from plm_five_classify_con pfcc where pfcc.five_classification_id = pfc.five_classification_id AND pfcc.change_iq = 'NORMAL' AND pfcc.approval_node = 'END_NODE') > 0 then (select count(*) from plm_five_classify_con pfcc where pfcc.final_classification_result = 'SECONDARY' AND pfcc.five_classification_id = pfc.five_classification_id AND pfcc.change_iq = 'NORMAL' AND pfcc.approval_node = 'END_NODE') else ( select count(*) from plm_five_classify_con pfcc where pfcc.final_classification_result = 'SECONDARY' AND pfcc.five_classification_id = pfc.five_classification_id AND pfcc.change_iq = 'NORMAL' AND pfcc.approval_node = 'FIRST_NODE' ) end ) AS secondary_number,
( case when (select count(*) from plm_five_classify_con pfcc where pfcc.five_classification_id = pfc.five_classification_id AND pfcc.change_iq = 'NORMAL' AND pfcc.approval_node = 'END_NODE') > 0 then (select count(*) from plm_five_classify_con pfcc where pfcc.final_classification_result = 'ATTENTION' AND pfcc.five_classification_id = pfc.five_classification_id AND pfcc.change_iq = 'NORMAL' AND pfcc.approval_node = 'END_NODE') else ( select count(*) from plm_five_classify_con pfcc where pfcc.final_classification_result = 'ATTENTION' AND pfcc.five_classification_id = pfc.five_classification_id AND pfcc.change_iq = 'NORMAL' AND pfcc.approval_node = 'FIRST_NODE' ) end ) AS attention_number,
( case when (select count(*) from plm_five_classify_con pfcc where pfcc.five_classification_id = pfc.five_classification_id AND pfcc.change_iq = 'NORMAL' AND pfcc.approval_node = 'END_NODE') > 0 then (select count(*) from plm_five_classify_con pfcc where pfcc.final_classification_result = 'NORMAL' AND pfcc.five_classification_id = pfc.five_classification_id AND pfcc.change_iq = 'NORMAL' AND pfcc.approval_node = 'END_NODE') else ( select count(*) from plm_five_classify_con pfcc where pfcc.final_classification_result = 'NORMAL' AND pfcc.five_classification_id = pfc.five_classification_id AND pfcc.change_iq = 'NORMAL' AND pfcc.approval_node = 'FIRST_NODE' ) end ) AS normal_number, fpcc.approval_number, fpcc.unit_name, fpcc.bp_name, fpcc.final_classification_time, fpcc.final_classification_result FROM plm_five_classification pfc LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pc.five_classification_id, wm_concat(DISTINCT fc.approval_number) approval_number, wm_concat(DISTINCT fou.unit_name) unit_name, wm_concat( DISTINCT hbm.bp_name) bp_name, wm_concat(DISTINCT pc.final_classification_time) final_classification_time, wm_concat(DISTINCT sc.meaning) final_classification_result FROM plm_five_classify_con pc JOIN fct_contract fc ON fc.contract_id=pc.contract_id AND pc.contract_type='FCT' JOIN fnd_org_unit fou ON fou.unit_Id=fc.unit_Id JOIN fct_project_bp pb ON pb.project_id=fc.project_Id AND pb.credit_grantor_party='Y' JOIN hls_bp_master hbm ON pb.bp_id=hbm.bp_id LEFT JOIN sc ON sc.code_value=pc.final_classification_result AND sc.code='PLM.FC_RESULT' GROUP BY pc.five_classification_id union all
SELECT pc.five_classification_id, wm_concat(DISTINCT pp.approval_number) approval_number, wm_concat(DISTINCT fou.unit_name) unit_name, wm_concat( DISTINCT hbm.bp_name) bp_name, wm_concat(DISTINCT pc.final_classification_time) final_classification_time, wm_concat(DISTINCT sc.meaning) final_classification_result FROM plm_five_classify_con pc JOIN con_contract fc ON fc.contract_id=pc.contract_id AND pc.contract_type='CON' JOIN prj_project pp ON pp.project_id=fc.project_id JOIN fnd_org_unit fou ON fou.unit_Id=fc.unit_Id JOIN hls_bp_master hbm ON hbm.bp_id=fc.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sc ON sc.code_value=pc.final_classification_result AND sc.code='PLM.FC_RESULT' GROUP BY pc.five_classification_id ) fpcc ON fpcc.five_classification_id=pfc.five_classification_id
pfc.five_classification_type = 'FC'
AND pfc.five_classification_id = #{fiveClassificationId}
AND to_char(pfc.creation_date, 'yyyy/mm/dd' ) >=to_char(to_date(#{creationDateFrom},'yyyy/mm/dd'),'yyyy/mm/dd')
AND to_char(pfc.creation_date, 'yyyy/mm/dd' ) <=to_char(to_date(#{creationDateTo},'yyyy/mm/dd'),'yyyy/mm/dd')
AND pfc.status IN
#{item}
order by five_classification_number desc

SELECT pfc.* FROM plm_five_classification pfc WHERE pfc.five_classification_type = #{fiveClassificationType} AND pfc.belongs_to_id = #{belongsToId}

SELECT pfc.* FROM plm_five_classification pfc WHERE 1=1
and pfc.five_classification_id = #{fiveClassificationId}
